summary: Iteration 27 — Frontend-only verification of the 3 new follow-up features on top of iter 26. All 3 PASS end-to-end in headless Chromium via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. (A) PAD BANK PAGES: [data-testid=pad-page-switcher] renders in the jingle bar with [data-testid=pad-page-label] showing '1/2'. Only [data-testid=jingle-pad-0..5] are in the DOM on page 1; jingle-pad-6..11 are NOT rendered. Clicking [data-testid=pad-page-next] flips label to '2/2', renders jingle-pad-6..11 whose unassigned button text reads 'Pad 7'..'Pad 12'. [data-testid=pad-page-prev] returns to '1/2'. Assigned a synthesized WAV to [data-testid=jingle-pad-6] via [data-testid=jingle-file-input] (opened by clicking the empty pad); pad label became 'testwav.wav' and PERSISTED across a prev→next page flip. No console errors during any of this. (B) FX PRESETS in Voice Booth: opened [data-testid=voice-recorder-modal] via [data-testid=record-voice-button] (required a selected playlist per iter 26). [data-testid=voice-fx-chain] contains a [data-testid=voice-fx-presets] block with [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-name] input and [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-save] button. Set [data-testid=voice-pad-db]=6, enabled [data-testid=voice-comp-toggle] & [data-testid=voice-gate-toggle] (verified [data-testid=voice-comp-threshold] and [data-testid=voice-gate-threshold] appeared). Saved as 'Warm' → [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-Warm] chip appeared under [data-testid=voice-fx-preset-chips]. Reset pad to 0 and turned comp+gate OFF (verified sub-sliders disappeared). Clicked the Warm chip → pad snapped back to 6, comp/gate re-enabled, sub-sliders reappeared. Clicked chip trash button → chip removed. (C) STEM RECORD: opened [data-testid=stem-isolator-modal] via [data-testid=open-stem-isolator]; selected the seeded 'testwav' via [data-testid=stem-source-select] (loads buffer, transport renders). Clicked [data-testid=stem-record-mix] — [data-testid=stem-source-select] became disabled, the button label showed '0:00' (running timer with mm:ss + Square icon). Rode [data-testid=stem-mute-vocals] on/off during ~1.8s of recording, then clicked stem-record-mix again to stop. A WAV file 'testwav - Stem Mix.wav' downloaded (verified via Playwright download event) and [data-testid=stem-flash] showed 'Stem mix saved'. Confirmed the recorder is wired to the Web Audio graph output (recDestRef connects to graph.master in startAt), so it works headless without mic access.

issues: Carry-over from iter 20-26: visual-editor injects <span> into <option>, producing a React hydration warning. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Carry-over, low) Remove visual-editor <span>-in-<option> injection in PlayerBar to clear the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: JingleBar.js: PAGE_COUNT=2 and pad indexing i = padPage*PAD_COUNT + idx is clean; only the current page's pads are rendered which keeps the DOM small. Consider adding data-testid on the input for programmatic drag-drop tests, but jingle-file-input is enough today.

VoiceRecorder.js: FX presets store under localStorage key 'hotlive95_fx_presets'; saveFxPreset dedupes by name and persists. applyFxPreset restores all 7 fields with safe defaults. Chip data-testid uses name.replace(/\s/g,'-') which is fine for single-word names but will collide/mis-testid if two preset names differ only in whitespace or contain special chars — consider slugifying/encoding.

StemIsolator.js: recDestRef connects to graph.master and startAt re-hooks it on every buffer restart, so loop/seek during recording keep capturing — good. onstop decodes webm → WAV via bufferToWav and downloads. downloadBlob usage is correct. Nit: recording flow does not gracefully handle a user closing the modal mid-record (teardown() stops recorder but recBusy/onstop still fires after context is closing) — the try/catch guards it but the flash won't be shown. Low priority.
StemIsolator.js: source select is correctly disabled while recording (verified) — prevents user from swapping the buffer mid-take.
No regressions on iter-26 features (license gate, jingle bar layout, voice booth DSP chain, stem isolator core).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 3 new features (Pad Bank Pages, FX Presets, Stem Record).
